result.summary: One clear visual defect: the hero image for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' failed to load and shows a generic broken-image placeholder. The rest of the page (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousel, bottom nav) renders correctly. The clipped carousel/chip items and the cut-off pizza card are expected scroll behavior and are not reported.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' shows a flat gray box with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo. It is the most prominent card on screen, so it looks unfinished and makes the restaurant less appealing.
issues.suggestion: Check the image URL, loading, and caching for this listing. Add a graceful fallback, such as a cuisine-themed illustration, brand color, or restaurant logo, instead of the generic broken-image glyph. Optionally show a shimmer skeleton while the image loads.
